_readme: Copy the keys you need into cypress.env.json in your project root (or set them as CYPRESS_<KEY> env vars in CI). Everything defaults to ON — the only required key is a sink: CLR_DB (postgres) or CLR_WEBHOOK. Every value below is shown at its built-in default; delete anything you don't override. Sibling _doc keys are documentation and are ignored by the plugin.
_CLR_DB_doc: Postgres connection string. Presence selects postgres mode. Apply schema.sql once before the first run.
_CLR_WEBHOOK_doc: Webhook URL. Used only when CLR_DB is unset (webhook mode). Receives one JSON event per POST.
_CLR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN_doc: Optional bearer token sent as the Authorization header on webhook requests.
_CLR_RUN_ID_doc: Override the run id (default: a fresh UUID per run). Use the SAME value across parallel machines to merge them into one run. Must be UUID-shaped in postgres mode.
_CLR_PROJECT_ID_doc: Free-form id that groups many runs under one project, e.g. 'todos-web'. Surfaced as the clr_run_project view and clr_runs.project_id.
_CLR_ENABLED_doc: Master switch. false disables the reporter entirely, silently.
_CLR_DEBUG_doc: Log every send + swallowed error to the console.
_CLR_RUN_LIFECYCLE_doc: run:start / spec:start / spec:end / run:end from the Node side.
_CLR_LIVE_TESTS_doc: test:start / test:attempt:end from the browser — the live per-it-block feed.
_CLR_SCREENSHOTS_doc: Ship failure screenshots as artifact:screenshot events.
_CLR_SCREENSHOTS_STORAGE_doc: "db" = base64 inside the payload (default). "s3" = upload, payload carries `url`.
_CLR_COMMANDS_doc: On failure, ship the last N Cypress commands (name + args + pass/fail + ms). Cheap, no DOM.
_CLR_COMMANDS_DEPTH_doc: How many commands to keep in the ring before failure (1-50).
_CLR_CONSOLE_doc: On failure, ship the last N browser console lines (console.* from the app).
_CLR_CONSOLE_DEPTH_doc: How many console lines to keep before failure (1-200). 8 is the sweet spot.
_CLR_STDOUT_doc: For FAILING specs only, ship node-side terminal output (cy.task / plugin / server logs) as artifact:stdout.
_CLR_STDOUT_MAX_BYTES_doc: Cap on captured stdout per spec (keeps the tail).
_CLR_DOM_doc: Serialize the DOM at the moment of failure (artifact:dom).
_CLR_DOM_BACKTRACK_doc: 0 = off (recommended for CI gates). 1-5 = also keep DOM snapshots of the last N commands before failure. Costs 10-50ms per command.
_CLR_S3_BUCKET_doc: Required for any "s3" storage mode. Missing bucket -> warn once, fall back to db.
_CLR_S3_ENDPOINT_doc: Set for R2 / MinIO (enables path-style addressing). Credentials come from standard AWS env vars.
_CLR_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_doc: Optional CDN/public base used to build artifact links instead of the raw bucket URL.
_CLR_MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS_doc: Concurrency gate for in-flight sends; overflow queues FIFO.
_CLR_TIMEOUT_MS_doc: Per-send timeout (webhook abort / pg statement timeout).
_CLR_FINAL_FLUSH_MS_doc: Hard cap on the one and only wait: draining the queue in after:run.
